exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "When (Verb-たときに)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞たときに matches "When (Verb-たときに)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞たときに.
exercises.explanation: Used after past verbs to specify when something happened.
